fields.label: History (days)
fields.description: Average daily demand = demand in these last days ÷ days.

fields.label: Near margin (%)
fields.description: Items within this much above their re-order level show as Near.

fields.label: Lead days per stage
fields.description: Days used drives the re-order levels. The learned medians beside it are a guide, refreshed nightly: Work Order creation to its last Manufacture entry (in-house), Subcontracting Order date to its last Subcontracting Receipt (job work).

fields.label: Use learned days where Days used is empty
fields.description: Off: only Days used counts. Learned medians include time waiting before an order starts (on live, dyeing orders take 25 days from creation but half a day from first transfer), so check them first.

fields.label: Include bought materials' lead days
fields.description: Off: a made item's lead days stop at its bought material (yarn), which has its own re-order level. On: the supplier's lead days are added too (finished fabric 15 + yarn 10 = 25).

fields.label: Warehouse for planned requests
fields.description: Where Material Requests from a plan expect the goods (each item's default warehouse is used first).

fields.label: Made-to-stock projects
fields.description: Made-to-stock plans go to one project per item family and period. Family = the Item's Commercial Name (else its top item group).

fields.label: Project name
fields.description: {YY} or {YYYY}, {FAMILY}, {PERIOD} (Q4, OCT or the season's name), {SEQ} (01, 02 … per family and period: every new plan gets its own project). Without {SEQ}, one project per family and period is reused.

fields.label: Supplier lead days
fields.description: Where a bought item's lead days come from: the first source switched on that has a number wins. Supplier lead days themselves are entered on the Supplier (Usual lead days) and on the Item's Supplier Items rows (Lead days) — or on the planning app's Re-order Settings page.

fields.label: Otherwise, when an item has no default supplier
fields.options:
Latest Purchase Order
Most bought from
No supplier
fields.description: Which supplier's lead days count for an item without a Default Supplier. Most bought from looks back over Learn from the last (months).

fields.label: Purchase Order lead time check
fields.description: Block: a Purchase Order can't be submitted when a line's Required By is earlier than the order date + the supplier's lead days. Only supplier lead days block; item and group lead days only warn. Override roles are the ones in Stock Reservation Settings.

fields.label: Grace days
fields.description: A line this many days short still passes.

fields.label: When it has Item Lead Days rows
fields.description: For an item with no Default Supplier: plan with the slowest (safe, more stock) or the fastest (lean) supplier among its Item Lead Days rows. Items without rows use the setting below.
